schema:name: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Pallasite Phosphate Spot v1
schema:description: laicpmsTAPP instance derived from Chernonozhkin et al. 2021 (Chem Geol 562) Pallasite phosphate Spot analysis ns-LA-SF-ICP-MS Ghent University (column P of LA-Q_SF-ICPMS_TAPP_v2.xlsx 'TAPP' worksheet).

schema:location.schema:name: Dept. of Chemistry, Atomic & Mass Spectrometry, Ghent University, Belgium

ada:sampleFormAnalyticalSubstrateDefault: In situ — polished epoxy thick section
ada:samplePreparationMethodDefault: PMG thick sections polished; same as olivine mapping preparation
ada:laserManufacturerModel: Teledyne CETAC Technologies Analyte G2 (193 nm ArF excimer)
ada:interfaceConeConfiguration: Al standard sample cone (1.1 mm aperture); Al H-type skimmer (0.8 mm aperture)
ada:laserWavelengthAndType: 193 nm ArF excimer; pulse duration ~5 ns
ada:ablationDurationPerSpotDefault: 20 s spot ablation (plus 10 s washout); 25 cycles acquisition
ada:carrierGasAndFlowRateDefault: He: MFC-1 0.270 l min⁻¹; MFC-2 0.250 l min⁻¹
ada:analysisSequenceDefault: MPI-DING and USGS GRMs at beginning → unknowns → repeated GRM at end
ada:backgroundCountTimeDefault: 8 gas blank scans; 11 ablation scans (25 cycles measurement: 15 s blank + 20 s ablation + 10 s washout)
ada:internalStandardApproach: Sum-of-major-oxide normalization to 100 wt% (Liu et al. 2008; Appendix C3)
ada:internalStandardElement: No single IS; oxide sum normalization to 100 wt%
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: Oxide sum normalization to 100 wt% corrects for ablation yield and matrix effects; external calibration with MPI-DING and USGS glass GRMs
ada:signalIntegrationIntervalMethod: Anomalous time steps excluded (inclusions, cracks, heterogeneity); manual inspection
ada:blankBackgroundCorrectionMethod: Gas blank measured before each spot analysis (8 scans); average background subtracted
ada:primaryCalibrationStandardNameDefaul: MPI-DING and USGS glass GRMs (measured at beginning and repeatedly at end of each session; multipoint calibration)
ada:secondaryReferenceMaterialsDefault: Same MPI-DING and USGS glasses measured as unknowns for accuracy assessment

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Plasma / Make-up Gas Addition
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Ar make-up: 0.96 l min⁻¹; N₂ not added

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Auxiliary and Cool Gas Flow Rates
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Cool: 15 l min⁻¹ Ar; Auxiliary: 0.85 l min⁻¹

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: ICP Tuning
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Same instrument as olivine runs; tuned for normal plasma conditions

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Drift Monitor Frequency
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: MPI-DING and USGS GRMs measured at beginning and repeatedly at end of each session

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Multi-Run Sequential Analysis Design
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Single spot analysis run per location (25 cycles: 15 s blank + 20 s ablation + 10 s washout); 3 replicates

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Uncertainty Propagation Method
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Longerich et al. (1996) for LOD; uncertainty not formally described

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Anomalous time steps excluded during manual inspection

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Memory Effect Mitigation
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: 10 s washout time after 20 s spot ablation (specified in acquisition protocol)

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: 100% oxide sum normalization to 100 wt% for phosphate minerals (Appendix C3)

ada:methodParameters.schema:name: Additional Notes
ada:methodParameters.schema:defaultValue: Phosphate phase identification used LA-ICP-MS data combined with EMPA and µXRF (Fig. D9); merrillite, stanfieldite, farringtonite distinguished by REE patterns; oxide sum normalization applied to phosphate (not olivine IS approach)

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Analyzed constituent
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Analyzed constituent (isotope) identified by the analyte row.
